scripts.build: node -e "if(process.env.BACKEND_URL) require('fs').writeFileSync('src/environments/environment.prod.ts', 'export const environment = { production: true, apiBaseUrl: \"' + process.env.BACKEND_URL.replace(/\/+$/, '') + '\" };\n')" && npx ng build && node -e "if(require('fs').existsSync('src/_redirects')) require('fs').copyFileSync('src/_redirects', 'dist/frontend/browser/_redirects'); else require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/frontend/browser/_redirects', '/* /index.html 200\n');"
